name: StableToolBench
intro: StableToolBench是一个旨在解决工具学习基准不稳定问题的项目。它通过引入虚拟API服务器和稳定的评估系统，在ToolBench的基础上进行了改进。虚拟API服务器结合了缓存系统和API模拟器，以减轻API状态变化带来的影响；而稳定的评估系统则利用GPT-4作为自动评估器，设计了可解的通过率和获胜率，以消除评估过程中的随机性。
build_method: ToolBench迁移, 缓存与API模拟, 三模型可解性筛选
metric: Solvable Pass Rate, Solvable Win Rate
eval_feature: 虚拟API服务器, 稳定评估系统
build_method_en: ToolBench migration, cache and API simulation, three-model solvability filtering
eval_feature_en: Virtual API server, Stability evaluation system
intro_en: StableToolBench is a project aimed at addressing the instability issues in tool learning benchmarks. It improves upon ToolBench by introducing a virtual API server and a stable evaluation system. The virtual API server combines a caching system and an API simulator to mitigate the impact of API state changes, while the stable evaluation system uses GPT-4 as an automatic evaluator and designs solvable pass rates and win rates to eliminate randomness in the evaluation process.
metric_en: Solvable Pass Rate, Solvable Win Rate

drawio_review_note: Aligned with StableToolBench arXiv:2403.07714 Sections 2-4 and Appendices D, F-H; official THUNLP-MT/StableToolBench repository. StableToolBench evolves ToolBench's 1,100 ToolEval2 test queries into a stable virtual-API and evaluation setup. The cache is initialized from ToolBench training and reproduced-test API histories, filters invalid records while retaining selected realistic exceptions, and had 164,980 filtered records at the paper snapshot. For each call, the server checks the cache, then tries the real API, then uses GPT-4-turbo to simulate unavailable responses from the API documentation with up to five cached few-shot examples; returned responses update the cache. GPT-4-turbo, Gemini-Pro, and Claude-2 independently judge every ToolBench query, and a majority-solvable rule retains 765 tasks. Models execute the queries through the virtual server. GPT-4-turbo grades answers solved, unsure, or unsolved. Solvable Pass Rate assigns 1, 0.5, or 0 respectively; Solvable Win Rate compares paired candidates, using deterministic solved-versus-unsolved wins and GPT-4-turbo for the remaining cases.
